days.brief: Exmouth is the pick of WA today: sunny, 29° with a gentle breeze. The set-up: a cold front brings cooler, showery weather to the south; high pressure is building over the south-west, which means settled, dry air and mostly light winds; an inland trough sits further east, where it is hotter and more unsettled. Denham, Rottnest Island and Kalbarri are not far behind. Least appealing: Telfer, with 41° heat.

Mandurah and Busselton lead the way tomorrow: partly cloudy, around 28° with a gentle breeze. The set-up: a cold front brings cooler, showery weather to the south at some stage; high pressure is building over the south-west, which means settled, dry air and mostly light winds; an inland trough sits further east, where it is hotter and more unsettled. That is exactly what makes the south the place to be. Harvey, Yallingup and Rockingham are not far behind. Least appealing: Telfer, with 41° heat.

Yallingup is the pick of WA on Tuesday: mostly sunny, 27° with light winds. The set-up: a cold front brings cooler, showery weather to the south at some stage; high pressure is building over the south-west, which means settled, dry air and mostly light winds; an inland trough sits further east, where it is hotter and more unsettled. That is exactly what makes the south the place to be. Busselton, Pemberton and Bridgetown are not far behind. Least appealing: Telfer, with 40° heat and possible storm. windy.

Exmouth and Ellenbrook lead the way on Wednesday: partly cloudy, around 28° with a gentle breeze. Perth, Joondalup and Rockingham are not far behind. Least appealing: Fitzroy Crossing, with 40° heat and sunny morning. possible storm.
Moora and Eneabba lead the way on Thursday: partly cloudy, around 27° with a gentle breeze. Northampton, Katanning and Lake Grace are not far behind. Least appealing: Fitzroy Crossing, with 41° heat.

Mullewa and Southern Cross lead the way on Friday: mostly sunny, around 28° with a gentle breeze. Mukinbudin, Carnarvon and Dalwallinu are not far behind. Least appealing: Kununurra, with 40° heat and sticky air.

Exmouth is the pick of WA on Saturday: mostly sunny, 29° with a gentle breeze. Mount Augustus, Paynes Find and Kambalda are not far behind. Least appealing: Kiwirrkurra, with 41° heat and strong winds.
